lens: Every number printed in the journal article and its display items, re-derived from the committed artifact that produces it — counts, fractions, percentages, intervals, base-pair lengths, thermodynamic separations, power and threshold figures — plus agreement between every copy of the same quantity across the article, tables, extended report, cover letter and the built .docx.
central_claim: Every quantity the journal article prints — the 190-design/38-junction panel and its 87/61/85 liability counts, the 45.8/33.1/25.4 geometry ladder, the 93-of-190 union, the 40.6-vs-45.8 null comparison and its Wilson containment, the 68.4%/39.9-82.8%/79.0% coverage figures, the 8 and 9 bp parent duplexes, the 3.2/3.0 kcal/mol separations, the 10.0%/3.9% scramble rates and the noncentral-t power and void-SD figures — is the number its own committed producing artifact actually yields when the derivation is re-run from the source rows rather than matched against a value stored beside it.

p2s.summary: "61 of the 87 do so against wild-type NR4A3" is the screen's ATTRIBUTION (the parent supplying the longest duplex), not the count of designs that actually pair wild-type NR4A3 through the whole catalytic gap at the criterion, which is 62. The sentence's literal reading selects the larger number, and the article carries no word marking the difference.
p2s.evidence: research/manuscripts/aso/fusion-junction-aso-journal-article.md: "Of those, 87 let one of six mature wild-type parent transcripts pair their entire catalytic gap over a contiguous duplex of at least ten base pairs, and 61 of the 87 do so against wild-type *NR4A3*" (Abstract restates it as "61 against wild-type NR4A3 itself"). The 61 is research/modalities/aso-parent-gap-pairing.json corpus.which_parent_supplies_it.NR4A3 = 61, a per-design attribution to the single gene giving the LONGEST run (per_design records carry one `parent` field only). research/modalities/aso-parent-null.json cut_sensitivity.observed_cut_ladder.10 carries BOTH readings side by side: n_liable_attributed_to_NR4A3 = 61 and n_pairing_NR4A3_specifically = 62. I re-derived the whole screen from raw sequence (mature transcripts rebuilt from research/modalities/aso-premrna-sequences.json exon_spans_0based_inclusive; longest gap-spanning exact substring per parent, min_duplex_bp = 10): 87 liable, 61 attributed to NR4A3, 85 own-parent, run-length distribution 0:9 6:6 7:32 8:45 9:11 10:3 11:49 12:29 13:6 — zero disagreements with the artifact's per-design runs — and 62 designs pair NR4A3's whole gap at >=10 bp. The 62nd is GCATATCAGCATCTGT at TAF15_e9__NR4A3_e3, which pairs wild-type NR4A3 over 11 bp through the gap but is attributed to TAF15 at 12 bp. The guard (research/manuscripts/tests/test_journal_article_numbers.py::test_the_panel_and_its_liable_count_are_the_screens_own) names it correctly as "the screen's attribution"; only the prose does not.
